authorized.hint: Apps you let sign in as you. Revoking cuts off access immediately.
authorized.empty: No app has access to your account.
authorized.personalNote: Only you can see and revoke these apps. Connectors belong to a workspace or Space and are managed in Apps & Integrations.
authorized.revokeBody: The app loses access to your account at once. You can authorize it again later.

clients.hint: Register an app that signs users in with OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE).
clients.name: App name
clients.redirects: Redirect URIs (one per line, exact match)
clients.secretHint: Copy it now. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
clients.registerDescription: Name the app and list every redirect URI it may use. The secret is shown once.
clients.removeBody: Apps using this client can no longer sign users in.

consent.title: Authorize {{name}}
consent.intro: {{name}} wants to access your account. It can never do more than you can.
consent.invalid: This authorization request is not valid.
